definition: A commitment to provide early detection, warning, alert dissemination or emergency communication capability: multi-hazard warning systems, cell broadcast alerts, emergency messaging, public warning platforms, and communication systems for disaster response, which this project finances, deploys or requires. Does not count: a warning system described only as context, a lesson or another agency's existing service; and the day-to-day operation of an emergency call centre is not itself a warning capability unless the passage commits to warning, alerting or emergency communication infrastructure.
note: First measure after climate risk assessment, tried 2026-10-19 to see how a measure that is itself a digital asset (the asset map's drm_ews) behaves through the funnel. v2 2026-10-20: Dev's narrower wording; call-centre operations no longer count on their own.
